Maya L: Quick design sync: proposal for a tenant-safe "precision corridor" — a small set of allowed activation precisions per model (e.g., [fp32, fp8, int8]) and a ranked fallback policy that prioritizes quality. Aim: avoid exotic 4-bit fallbacks except when longctx cost imperative.

Parker H: corridor concept is neat. how do we pick rankings? per-model eval profiles?

Maya L: yes, offline evals produce a ranked list with cost/quality delta annotations. runtime uses corridor + budget signals (latency/memory) to pick lowest-rank precision that meets budget.

Iris V: important: record the chosen precision in the trace and in KV metadata so downstream replays are consistent. also provide tenant override via model manifest.

Maya L: rollout: start as shadow-only (0.5% traffic) with strict logging, then canary. ops-bot: create corridor-canary-2026-03-27.

ops-bot: canary queued. :robot_face:
